property.name: Gator Go Resort & Spa
property.notice: Fictional hotel and sample policies created for a course-project prototype. Replace this file with the team's approved hotel knowledge base before presenting facts as official.

policies.answer: Standard check-in begins at 3:00 PM. Early check-in may be requested, but availability must be confirmed by staff.
Check-out is at 11:00 AM. Please ask staff if you need a late check-out; it is not guaranteed.
Complimentary guest Wi-Fi is available. Connect to the sample network ‘GatorGuest’; front desk staff can provide the current access instructions.
For this fictional property, self-parking is included for registered guests. Staff can explain the parking location at arrival.
The sample Palmetto Kitchen serves breakfast daily from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM. Meal inclusion depends on the guest's reservation.
Palmetto Kitchen is the sample on-site restaurant. Breakfast is listed as 7:00–11:00 AM; staff can confirm other meal hours and reservations.
The fictional Serenity Spa is open 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM. Treatments are by appointment; this demo can answer questions but cannot book one.
The sample resort pool is open from 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Check with hotel staff for temporary closures or weather restrictions.
The sample fitness center is open 24 hours for registered guests. Staff can help with access instructions.
The fictional resort observes quiet hours from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM. If noise is affecting your stay, I can prepare a demo staff handoff.
Service animals are welcome. Other pet accommodations and any fees need to be confirmed directly with staff; this demo does not have an approved pet policy.
Cancellation terms depend on your booking and rate. Please review your confirmation or ask a front desk staff member. I cannot cancel a reservation.
For accessible-room options or accommodation requests, I can prepare a staff handoff. Availability and specific features must be confirmed by the hotel.
